turns.assessment: The outage is a bidirectional hard loss on the physical span adjacent to S15 between S04 and S15. OSC_LOS occurs simultaneously on oms.S04-S15.span2 and the reverse-direction counterpart oms.S15-S04.span0, while the downstream amplifier reports input LOS and many channels/services fail together. This paired OSC and signal loss strongly identifies a cable fibre cut rather than an amplifier or channel-specific fault.

proposals.rationale: E8 (oms.S04-S15.span2) and reverse-direction E14 represent the two fibres of the same physical span. Their simultaneous OSC_LOS, together with downstream AMP_INPUT_LOS and widespread OCH/service loss, is the documented signature of a cable cut affecting both fibres.
An exceptionally large added loss could suppress both payload and OSC, but simultaneous hard loss in both directional fibres is substantially more characteristic of a fibre cut.
